styleGuide.name: FICSIT industrial
rules: Industrial machines and infrastructure share dark steel bodies and restrained orange/yellow accents.
Resource models retain their material identity and natural variation.
Items use material-appropriate colours; do not force a single palette onto copper, limestone, flora or fauna.
Selected variants must be checked together at in-world scale before final approval.

selectionPolicy: One default variant is assigned for every current catalogue family. Items marked provisional have not yet had all four preview variants manually reviewed; do not treat those choices as final.
